# larm Provider

Official Terraform provider for [Larm](https://larm.dev) — uptime monitoring and status pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    larm = {
      source  = "larmhq/larm"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "larm" {
  # api_key is also read from the LARM_API_KEY environment variable
  api_key = var.larm_api_key
}

variable "larm_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the Larm API. Create one in Settings > API Keys. Can also be set via the `LARM_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Larm API. Defaults to `https://app.larm.dev/api/v1`. Can also be set via the `LARM_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
